releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194 remains unchanged. Web Update 340 improves World Clock search with typo-tolerant city matching; all World Clock smart tools and existing Diary features remain.
webReleaseNotes: World Clock city search now accepts small spelling mistakes, joined words, accents and partial names, and ranks exact matches first. Example searches include Londn, Pariss, Krachi and Newyork. Favourite cities, day/night, Mumbai time difference, meeting planner, sunrise/sunset, saved cities and add/remove remain.
